items.title: Foreign borrowings hit over $6 billion in June as 140 firms tap global market
items.description: In June, external commercial borrowings and foreign currency convertible bonds amassed an impressive $6.07 billion. Prominent borrowers included Shriram Finance and Microsoft Corp India, while Air India acquired necessary funding for aircraft imports through a leasing company. A total of 140 companies participated in these significant financial maneuvers, with data from the Reserve Bank of India highlighting these crucial transactions.

items.title: Stocks in news: PB Fintech, LIC, Trent, Ola Electric, and Cipla
items.description: In a day of mixed economic signals, Indian markets displayed notable volatility before settling at a flat close. PB Fintech enjoyed a substantial rise in profits thanks to robust growth in insurance premiums. ONGC is also gearing up to ink deals with Venezuela for managing oil blocks. Simultaneously, Ola Electric and Cipla made headlines with their considerable investments in renewable energy initiatives.

items.title: Pre-market action: Here's the trade setup for today's session
items.description: Domestic equities experienced a slight uptick, with the Nifty finishing virtually unchanged despite gains across various sectors. Analysts predict a positive outlook for Indian equities moving forward. Lower Brent crude prices are favorable for inflation expectations. The India VIX declined, signaling decreased market anxiety. Additionally, foreign portfolio investors showed a tendency toward net buying on Wednesday.

items.title: CAS sparks trader backlash as losses mount, Sebi holds firm
items.description: Concerns are mounting among traders regarding the recent shift to a closing auction system, which has led to significant price volatility. Numerous market participants have reported unexpected losses, prompting authorities to engage with brokers to explore these issues. Despite regulators' attempts to bolster trader involvement, the contentious pricing mechanism continues to stir debate within the financial community.

items.title: No decision yet on merchant discount rate on UPI deals
items.description: Central bank governor Sanjay Malhotra stated it is premature to discuss UPI transaction charges. Discussions are ongoing regarding the payment mechanism's future and costs. The government is reportedly amending laws to allow merchant discount rates on select UPI transactions. This move follows Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman's introduction of a new bill. The central bank's current focus remains on strengthening UPI adoption across India.

items.title: Liquidity to peak in Sept, but big surplus won't last long: RBI
items.description: The Reserve Bank of India will absorb surplus liquidity from a special forex swap facility. This absorption will occur through higher currency in circulation and maturing forward positions. Banking system liquidity is expected to peak in September due to FCNR(B) deposit inflows. Economists anticipate a surplus of around ₹4-5 lakh crore in the banking system. The central bank will then begin withdrawing excess liquidity through durable absorption measures.

items.title: New framework to standardise interest rate rules on the anvil, says RBI
items.description: The Reserve Bank of India plans to standardize interest rate rules for all regulated entities. This new principle-based framework aims to increase transparency and ensure uniformity across lending. The proposed changes are unlikely to affect EMIs or bring NBFCs into the external benchmark regime. Governor Sanjay Malhotra stated this move will improve consumer protection and rationalise existing norms.

items.title: No case for early closure or extension of swap window: RBI
items.description: The Reserve Bank of India will not close the swap window early.  Robust foreign currency inflows have strengthened India's balance of payments position.  The central bank has not received any proposals for extending the deadline.  This facility allows banks to swap overseas borrowings at concessional rates.  The swap window has already attracted significant dollar inflows by July.

items.title: 'No US lawsuits filed yet, ready to defend on facts if needed': HDFC Bank CEO clarifies on governance allegations
items.description: HDFC Bank assured shareholders about its strong governance credentials. No US lawsuits have been filed against the bank following investigations. The bank's leadership stated they are well-positioned to defend any potential legal action. HDFC Bank is fundamentally strong with a pristine balance sheet. The integration with HDFC Limited is unlocking meaningful synergies for future growth.

items.title: South Korea’s Kospi tumbles 5% after 2-day rally, angry retail investors vow not to invest again
items.description: South Korea's benchmark Kospi extended its sharp decline on Thursday as a global technology selloff dragged heavyweight chipmakers Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix lower. The slump has intensified losses for retail investors and raised concerns over market concentration, while policymakers and analysts assess the outlook for the country's equity market.

items.title: Cummins India shares dip over 4% as Q1 net profit dips 8% to Rs 543 crore. Buy, sell or hold?
items.description: Cummins India reported an 8% year-on-year decline in June-quarter profit despite an 18% rise in revenue, driven by robust domestic sales. The company expects steady demand ahead, while HSBC retained its Buy rating with a Rs 6,500 target, citing growth potential in power generation, data centres, aftermarket services and exports.

items.title: MCX India among 5 F&O stocks with a sharp rise in futures open interest
items.description: As of August 5, there was a notable surge in futures open interest for nine stocks in the NSE F&O pack, contributing to a total increase in open interest of over 5% as compared to the previous trade. A significant uptick in futures open interest signifies substantial growth in the number of active, unexpired futures contracts in a specific security. This uptrend reflects an increasing number of participants either initiating new positions or expanding the size of their existing positions within the futures market.

items.title: HSBC’s top picks: Adani Ports, Titan Company among 10 stocks with upside potential of 37%. See full list
items.description: India could be on the verge of attracting about $25 billion in foreign equity inflows if global investors rebalance their portfolios, as fund managers increasingly look for refuge from volatility in AI heavy Asian markets, according to HSBC. And to lead that shift, the Wall Street major has selected 10 stocks. Here’s the full list.

items.title: Lone warriors! How two mid-tier tech stocks rewarded investors in Rs 10 lakh crore IT crash this year
items.description: Indian IT stocks have seen significant value erosion this year. However, Coforge and LTIMindtree have shown resilience and growth. These companies are performing well due to strong deal wins and AI integration. Analysts see mid-tier firms as more attractive than large caps now. Their performance offers investors a rare stable option in the sector.

items.title: New India Assurance among 5 stocks showing bullish RSI upswing
items.description: On August 5, five stocks in the Nifty500 pack that gained over 7% were highlighted in the RSI Trending Up scan, based on data from StockEdge.com. An uptrend signal is generated when the RSI value crosses above 50 from lower levels. “RSI trending up” indicates that Relative Strength Index (RSI) values are rising, suggesting strengthening momentum in the stock’s price action. This can indicate potential upward movement and is often used by traders to identify buying opportunities in momentum-driven markets.

items.title: How LIC minted Rs 21,000 crore in mark-to-market gains by betting against AI panic in 3 top IT stocks
items.description: LIC gained over Rs 21,000 crore from three top software exporters. This paper profit materialized within thirty-five days after a contrarian investment strategy. The insurer accumulated shares of Infosys, TCS, and HCL Technologies during the June quarter. This move reversed earlier investor pessimism surrounding artificial intelligence disruption fears. The IT sector has since rallied, reversing earlier sector pessimism.

items.title: Dividend alert! Last day to buy Maruti Suzuki, Grasim among 38 stocks for payouts. Do you own any?
items.description: As per SEBI's T+1 settlement cycle, investors must buy a company's shares at least one trading day before the record date to ensure the shares are credited to their demat accounts in time, and they become eligible for the corporate action. Accordingly, today is the last opportunity for investors to buy the shares so that they are credited to their accounts by Friday, making them eligible for the dividends.

items.title: Juniper Green Energy shares to list today. Check GMP ahead of debut
items.description: If the current GMP trend holds, the stock could debut at around Rs 248 per share. That said, investors should keep in mind that grey market premiums are unofficial indicators and may not accurately reflect the stock's actual listing performance.

items.title: MV Electrosystems shares to list today: GMP indicates 26% upside on debut
items.description: The IPO, which remained open for subscription from July 30 to August 3, witnessed an overwhelming response across investor categories. The issue was subscribed 188.85 times overall, reflecting robust demand.

items.title: Stocks to buy in 2026 for long term: DLF, BSE among 5 stocks that could give 10-40% return
items.description: Brokerages continue to see upside in a diverse set of stocks spanning real estate, metals, financial markets, FMCG and retail.We have collated a list of recommendations from top brokerage firms from ETNow and other sources:

items.title: Positive Breakout: These 11 stocks cross above their 200 DMAs
items.description: In the Nifty500 pack, 11 stocks' closing prices crossed above their 200 DMAs (Daily Moving Averages) on August 4, 2026, according to stockedge.com's technical scan data. Traders use the 200-day daily moving average (DMA) as a key indicator to determine a stock's overall trend. As long as the stock is priced above the 200-day SMA on the daily timeframe, it is generally considered to be in an overall uptrend. Take a look:

items.title: Rupee gains 26 paise to close at 95.11 against the US dollar
items.description: The Indian rupee gained twenty-six paise on Wednesday, ending the session at ninety-five point eleven per dollar. This positive movement was aided by a decrease in oil prices. In addition, the Reserve Bank of India opted to keep its key interest rates unchanged while awaiting more definitive inflation data, as the situation around oil prices remains unpredictable.

items.title: Govt mobilises Rs 31,552 crore via LIC offer for sale
items.description: The government successfully raised ₹31,552 crore through the Life Insurance Corp of India Offer for Sale. This significant mobilization increased the public ownership of LIC to ten percent ahead of schedule. The issue saw strong participation from both retail and institutional investors. Non-retail investors subscribed more than three times their allocated portion on the first day. This successful offering marks India's largest public offering to date.

items.title: Indian Bank raising $400 million in overseas loan; syndication underway
items.description: Indian Bank has embarked on a significant financial undertaking by securing a four-year loan worth $400 million, underwritten by CTBC of Taiwan and Commerzbank of Germany. The pricing for this loan ranges from 119 to 123 basis points over the SOFR rate. Currently in syndication, this initiative opens the door for additional banks to participate, with advantageous provisions from the Reserve Bank of India's special swap facility enhancing this opportunity.

items.title: Swan Defence shares rise 3% after securing order from Denmark’s Svitzer
items.description: Swan Defence and Heavy Industries shares gained nearly 3% after securing an order from Denmark-based Svitzer A/S to build four advanced TRAnsverse 3200 tugs. The vessels will be constructed at SDHI’s Pipavav yard in Gujarat, with deliveries scheduled from early 2028. The contract follows a global shipyard evaluation and strengthens the company’s export order pipeline.

items.title: Ace investor Madhusudan Kela cuts stake in this multibagger stock after 200% rally in a year. Do you own?
items.description: Ace investor Madhusudan Kela's family reduced its stake in Rashi Peripherals during the June quarter after the stock surged nearly 200% over the past year. The multibagger has rallied sharply since its 2025 lows, even as the company posted strong Q1 FY27 earnings with robust revenue and profit growth.

items.title: LG Electronics, APL Apollo Tubes among 7 mid & smallcap picks by Axis Securities for August
items.description: The Nifty 50 outperformed on the back of strong contributions from IT, Financials and select industrial companies. Midcap and Smallcap indices also participated in the rally but underperformed the benchmark, reflecting investors' preference for quality companies amid rich valuations. Here are 7 mid and smallcap stocks that bucked the trend, as listed by Axis Securities.

items.title: LIC shares fall after India’s largest OFS closes with oversubscription on both days
items.description: The government raised Rs 31,552 crore through LIC’s record Offer for Sale (OFS), selling a 6.5% stake after exercising the greenshoe option. The issue was oversubscribed, driven by strong retail and institutional demand. The stake sale helped LIC achieve the 10% public shareholding norm ahead of Sebi’s May 2027 deadline, while shares declined over 1% after the offer.

items.title: Sterlite Tech shares gain 4% on Rs 1,760 crore international order win
items.description: Sterlite Technologies shares saw an upswing on Thursday after the company secured a Rs 1,760 crore international order for high-density optical fibre cables. The three-year contract strengthens its global order book, enhances revenue visibility, and comes amid rising worldwide investments in telecom networks, fibre connectivity, AI infrastructure and digital infrastructure expansion.

items.title: HAL shares jump over 6%, extend gains for second straight session. What did its annual report reveal?
items.description: HAL shares surged over 6% after the company’s annual report highlighted a robust order book of Rs 2.55 lakh crore for FY26, offering 7-8 years of revenue visibility. The defence major expects growth to accelerate through supply chain stabilisation, capacity expansion, infrastructure investments, and faster production ramp-up of key platforms, supporting its long-term growth outlook.

items.title: F&O Radar: Call Ratio Spread strategy for Dixon this week
items.description: Dixon Technologies demonstrates a robust bullish technical structure on the daily charts, trading above key EMAs with RSI at 63.27. Choice Broking recommends a Call Ratio Spread strategy for August expiry, targetting Rs 14,685-14,800 upside. The strategy offers a 1:3.41 risk-reward with a maximum profit of Rs 19,337.

items.title: Neuland Laboratories shares jump over 6% after 975% YoY surge in Q1 profit
items.description: Neuland Laboratories shares rose sharply on Thursday after the drugmaker reported a 975% year-on-year surge in Q1 FY27 profit to Rs 147.4 crore. Revenue more than doubled, while EBITDA jumped 448%, driven by strong commercial product sales and encouraging performance across its CMS and GDS businesses.

items.title: Navin Fluorine shares surge 8% after Q1 profit more than doubles. Should you buy, sell or hold?
items.description: Navin Fluorine shares surged nearly 8% after the company posted a strong Q1FY27 performance, with profit more than doubling and revenue rising 44% YoY. Elara Securities retained its 'Buy' rating and Rs 9,158 target, citing robust growth in refrigerants, specialty chemicals and CDMO, along with a strong expansion pipeline that supports long-term earnings visibility.

items.title: PB Fintech shares gain 2% after Q1 results. Why Morgan Stanley, Nomura see up to 25% downside
items.description: PB Fintech shares rose after the Policybazaar parent reported a 92% YoY jump in Q1 FY27 net profit to Rs 163 crore. Operating revenue grew 40% to Rs 1,888 crore, while total insurance premium increased 41% to Rs 8,372 crore. PAT margin also improved to 9% from 6% a year ago.

items.title: Mutual funds increase stake in Ather Energy for 5th straight quarter. Bigger rally brewing?
items.description: Domestic institutional investors have steadily increased their Ather Energy stake for five quarters.  Ather Energy's production facilities operate at full capacity, yet demand continues to outpace supply.  The company's upcoming EL platform aims to expand its market and reduce costs significantly.  New production capacity is expected to remove bottlenecks and support margin performance.  Ather Energy's strong brand and consistent execution justify its premium valuation.

items.title: Buy, Sell or Hold: Citi recommends 'Sell' on United Breweries; Goldman Sachs maintains 'Buy' on Metro Brands
items.description: Goldman Sachs has reiterated its 'Buy' ratings on Metro Brands and Pidilite Industries after their latest quarterly earnings. While Metro Brands faces near-term margin pressure due to higher operating costs, the brokerage remains positive on its expansion plans. Pidilite impressed with strong revenue and EBITDA growth, prompting Goldman Sachs to raise its earnings estimates and maintain a positive long-term outlook.

items.title: FCRA 2026: Three regulatory changes reshaping foreign funding in India
items.description: The revised FCRA Rules 2026 introduce crucial changes tightening regulatory oversight on foreign funding in India. These reforms redefine key functionaries to restrict foreign control, demand disclosure of ultimate donors, and mandate state-wise operational tracking, signaling a stricter compliance landscape for non-profits.

items.title: Sensex rises 200 points, Nifty above 24,600 amid US-Iran peace hopes. What lies ahead?
items.description: Indian stock markets opened higher, extending previous session gains. Hopes for a Middle East crisis resolution and strong Q1 earnings fueled the positive sentiment. Several key sectors and broader markets also registered gains during the morning trade. US President Trump expressed optimism regarding ongoing negotiations with Iran. Analysts anticipate continued market strength driven by fundamental factors and demand.

items.title: RR Kabel among 5 stocks flashing bullish signals, hinting at a possible uptrend
items.description: Represented by a long white (or green) candlestick with no upper shadow and a small or non-existent lower shadow, it indicates strong buying pressure throughout the session. Traders interpret it as a signal that buyers were in control from the opening to the closing, often using such patterns for informed decisions about future price movements in financial markets.
